name: Saddleback Valley Town Center
description: Saddleback Valley Town Center is a popular open-air shopping destination in Mission Viejo, serving the affluent South Orange County community with a diverse mix of national retailers, dining options, and services. The center features convenient access from Marguerite Parkway and provides ample parking for shoppers visiting its well-maintained plaza layout.
summary: A community-focused open-air shopping center offering diverse retail, dining, and service options in the heart of Mission Viejo.
